name: RadioRoot
description: Radio button for picking one option from a set. Use inside `RadioGroup.Root`. Renders a `<span>` element and a hidden `<input>` beside it.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique identifying value of the radio in a group.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the radio as invalid, applying error styles. Sets `aria-invalid` on the `<span>` element. Inside an invalid `RadioGroup.Root`, the radio is always invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the radio, controlling its width and height. Inside `RadioGroup.Root`, falls back to the group's `size` when not set.

props.name: children
props.description: Element shown inside the radio in place of the default `Radio.IndicatorPrimitive`, such as a `Radio.IndicatorPrimitive` with custom props. Anything other than a single element is ignored and the default indicator is shown.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select the radio button.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Radio.Root.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
